strengthCatalog.title: Strong Acknowledgement
strengthCatalog.desc: Recognizes and restates the customer's concern early, so the customer knows they were heard.

strengthCatalog.title: Personalized Empathy
strengthCatalog.desc: Responds to the customer's specific situation with sincere, tailored empathy.

strengthCatalog.title: Effective Assurance
strengthCatalog.desc: Gives clear, confident assurance of ownership early in the call.

strengthCatalog.title: Excellent Rapport
strengthCatalog.desc: Builds a genuine, professional connection that makes the conversation comfortable.

strengthCatalog.title: Professional Tone
strengthCatalog.desc: Keeps an engaged, confident tone and a pace that fits the customer and the situation.

strengthCatalog.title: Strong Active Listening
strengthCatalog.desc: Captures details the first time and responds to what the customer actually said.

strengthCatalog.title: Successful De-escalation
strengthCatalog.desc: Calms a frustrated customer and moves the conversation toward a solution.

strengthCatalog.title: Clear, Simple Explanations
strengthCatalog.desc: Explains information in plain language the customer can easily follow.

strengthCatalog.title: Strong Call Opening
strengthCatalog.desc: Opens professionally and quickly sets a clear direction for the call.

strengthCatalog.title: Strong Call Closing
strengthCatalog.desc: Recaps what was done, confirms next steps, and closes professionally.

strengthCatalog.title: Recognizing Customer Loyalty
strengthCatalog.desc: Sincerely acknowledges the customer's tenure and relationship with the company.

strengthCatalog.title: Effective Probing
strengthCatalog.desc: Asks focused, relevant questions to understand the full concern before acting.

strengthCatalog.title: Confirming Customer Understanding
strengthCatalog.desc: Checks that the customer understands the information and the next steps.

strengthCatalog.title: Proper Hold Management
strengthCatalog.desc: Asks permission, gives a timeframe, and returns on time with an update.

strengthCatalog.title: Keeping the Customer Informed
strengthCatalog.desc: Narrates research and gives updates, so silence never goes unexplained.

strengthCatalog.title: Confident Call Control
strengthCatalog.desc: Guides the conversation with purpose while staying respectful and flexible.

strengthCatalog.title: Effective Ownership
strengthCatalog.desc: Takes personal responsibility for the concern from start to finish.

strengthCatalog.title: Strong Expectation Setting
strengthCatalog.desc: Sets accurate expectations about timeframes, next steps, and outcomes.

strengthCatalog.title: Correct Escalation
strengthCatalog.desc: Uses the correct escalation path at the right time and explains it clearly.

strengthCatalog.title: Proper Transfer Handling
strengthCatalog.desc: Transfers only when needed, explains why, and follows the correct handoff process.

strengthCatalog.title: Effective Customer Education
strengthCatalog.desc: Teaches the customer what they need to know to manage or prevent the issue.

strengthCatalog.title: Accurate Resolution
strengthCatalog.desc: Resolves the actual concern correctly and confirms the outcome with the customer.

strengthCatalog.title: Appropriate Customer Follow-Up
strengthCatalog.desc: Makes clear follow-up commitments when needed and explains how they will happen.

strengthCatalog.title: Correct ITG Utilization
strengthCatalog.desc: Follows the applicable ITG flow accurately and completely.

strengthCatalog.title: Good Technical Troubleshooting
strengthCatalog.desc: Works through troubleshooting in a logical, thorough sequence.

strengthCatalog.title: Correct Technical Diagnosis
strengthCatalog.desc: Identifies the correct root cause before recommending a solution.

strengthCatalog.title: Efficient Tools Navigation
strengthCatalog.desc: Moves through systems and tools efficiently while staying engaged with the customer.

strengthCatalog.title: Accurate Account Verification
strengthCatalog.desc: Completes verification correctly before accessing or changing the account.

strengthCatalog.title: Accurate Billing Explanation
strengthCatalog.desc: Explains charges, changes, and timelines accurately and in plain language.

strengthCatalog.title: Clear Pricing Explanation
strengthCatalog.desc: Explains pricing, promotional terms, and what changes afterward, with no surprises.

strengthCatalog.title: Helpful Payment Options Guidance
strengthCatalog.desc: Explains the payment options that fit the customer's situation clearly and accurately.

strengthCatalog.title: Effective Sales Discovery
strengthCatalog.desc: Asks about needs and usage before recommending a product or service.

strengthCatalog.title: Effective Plant the Seed
strengthCatalog.desc: Introduces a relevant idea naturally after the concern is resolved, without pressure.

strengthCatalog.title: Relevant Offer
strengthCatalog.desc: Recommends an offer that clearly connects to what the customer shared.

strengthCatalog.title: Clear Offer Value
strengthCatalog.desc: Explains the offer in terms of the benefits that matter to the customer.

strengthCatalog.title: Effective Objection Handling
strengthCatalog.desc: Acknowledges objections, clarifies the concern, and responds with relevant value.

strengthCatalog.title: Effective Retention Handling
strengthCatalog.desc: Recognizes cancellation risk and works to understand and address the reason.

strengthCatalog.title: Confident Sales Close
strengthCatalog.desc: Asks for the decision confidently and confirms exactly what the customer agreed to.

strengthCatalog.title: Reliable Attendance
strengthCatalog.desc: Works the scheduled shifts in the period reviewed, so the team can count on full coverage.

strengthCatalog.title: On-Time Starts
strengthCatalog.desc: Is logged in and ready at the start of shifts and when returning from breaks and lunch.

strengthCatalog.title: Strong Schedule Adherence
strengthCatalog.desc: Follows scheduled breaks, lunches, and log-out times, which keeps the queue covered.

strengthCatalog.title: Responsible Absence Notice
strengthCatalog.desc: When unable to work, gives notice early and through the correct call-out process.

strengthCatalog.title: Positive Team Engagement
strengthCatalog.desc: Takes part in huddles and team activities and brings a constructive attitude.

strengthCatalog.title: Supports Teammates
strengthCatalog.desc: Shares knowledge and helps peers, which strengthens the whole team.

strengthCatalog.title: Owns Development
strengthCatalog.desc: Asks for feedback, practices new skills, and follows through on development goals.

strengthCatalog.title: Resilience After Tough Calls
strengthCatalog.desc: Resets after a difficult interaction and brings a steady, professional tone to the next call.

Failure to Take Ownership of Repeat Contacts
Not Addressing Customer Objections or Concerns

sales: Failure to Identify Customer Buying Signals
Pitching Features Rather Than Customer Benefits
